_doc: PolyCleaver 2 run configuration — edit this file, then run:  polycleaver2   (or: python -m polycleaver2)
_doc2: Keys starting with _ are documentation comments and are ignored. More examples in examples/configs/.
_note_filename: Bulk structure file (CIF, POSCAR, … anything pymatgen reads). Relative paths are resolved against this config file's directory, then the current directory.
_note_thickness: Minimum slab thickness in Å (lower-bound preference). The algorithm collects all non-polar scaffold states and picks the thinnest one still ≥ target. Used when thickness_range is null.
_note_thickness_range: Optional range [min, max] in Å. When set, ALL valid non-polar terminations between min and max Å are generated and ranked — one CIF per unique termination. Set to null to use target_thickness instead.
_note_vacuum: Vacuum gap in Å above and below the slab.
_note_dipole: Maximum allowed |z-dipole| in eÅ. 0.3 is a tight criterion; raise to 0.5–1.0 if no slabs are found.
_note_auto_select: Sort accepted slabs by surface stability (broken bonds per Å², then symmetry, then coordination saturation). Most stable slab listed and numbered first.
_note_nonstoich: Allow non-stoichiometric slabs (net charge ≠ 0). Normally discarded. Set to true to keep them for reactivity studies where you plan to add H atoms manually. Such CIFs are named slab_hkl_N_NS.cif.
_note_mode: How to choose surface orientations. Options: 'single' | 'max' | 'list'
_note_single_hkl: Used when mode = 'single'. Miller index as [h, k, l].
_note_max_index: Used when mode = 'max'. Generate all symmetrically distinct hkl up to this value.
_note_custom_list: Used when mode = 'list'. List of [h, k, l] indices to try.
